about: Keys in the directories that the project posted itself: the app's live checks (a browser's virtual authenticator stood in for a passkey and was deleted after the run, so nothing sealed to those keys can ever be opened) and the keys made while recording the demo video (real passkeys of the builder). The register marks their lines, so none is mistaken for an outside user.
